description: Robot and work-order state machines. Any transition not listed here is illegal and must be rejected at runtime (p4maint/fleet/state_machine.py raises IllegalTransition). Staying in the same state is not a transition.

STANDBY.label: Standby
STANDBY.meaning: Healthy reserve unit, parked, available to replace an active robot.

ACTIVE.label: Active
ACTIVE.meaning: Assigned to a mission and following its mode cycle.

MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED.label: Maintenance required
MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED.meaning: Work order exists, waiting for a P5 bay. WARNING severity: keeps working its mission. CRITICAL severity: stops (IDLE) and its mission is handed to a standby immediately.

EN_ROUTE_P5.label: En route to P5
EN_ROUTE_P5.meaning: Bay reserved; driving to the P5 Repair Garage.

IN_GARAGE.label: In P5 garage
IN_GARAGE.meaning: In a P5 bay being repaired. Work orders are not raised for robots in this state.

RETURNED_TO_SERVICE.label: Returned to service
RETURNED_TO_SERVICE.meaning: Repair finished, released by P5, awaiting post-repair checkout.

DISABLED.label: Disabled in field
DISABLED.meaning: Failed before reaching P5 and cannot drive. Needs recovery. Added beyond the HUNCH minimum so an undetected failure has somewhere to go.

transitions.trigger: Assigned to a mission (for example as a replacement).
Work order created for a standby robot.
Work order cancelled (false alarm); robot keeps its mission.
Work order cancelled (false alarm); robot had no mission.
Failed while waiting for a bay.
Arrived at P5 and admitted to the reserved bay.
Failed on the way to P5.
Recovered and being moved to P5.
Repair complete; P5 releases the robot.
Post-repair checkout passed; joins the standby pool.
Post-repair checkout passed; assigned straight to a mission.
Post-repair checkout failed; new work order.

states.OPEN: Created and validated, not yet accepted into the P5 queue.
states.QUEUED: Waiting in the P5 queue for a bay.
states.DISPATCHED: Bay reserved; robot en route to P5.
states.IN_REPAIR: Robot is in the bay being repaired.
states.CANCELLED: Withdrawn (for example a false alarm cleared by an operator).

robot_state_coupling.robot_to: ACTIVE or STANDBY (whichever it came from)
